pr.title: Avoid reloading root certificates to improve concurrent performance

intent.summary: Speed up concurrent requests with verify=True by avoiding a redundant load_verify_locations() per connection: a module-level private _preloaded_ssl_context with the default certifi bundle is passed to urllib3 pools when verify is True; cert_verify() no longer sets conn.ca_certs/ca_cert_dir for verify=True; _urllib3_request_context also handles verify being a directory. Must keep verify=True/False/path/dir behavior unchanged.
